# Lower-third name badge on the talking-head edit

A broadcast lower third burned onto 8 seconds of the talking-head edit: name and role on a dark brown badge with a beige accent bar, on screen for 5 seconds and lifted above the burned-in captions and edit bar.

- Type: Lower third
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `lower-third`
- Output: 1920x1080, 8 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f05-lower-third.mp4`](../videos/f05-lower-third.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Add a lower third to ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4. Use the 8 seconds from 2.5 s, where she starts "We're a digital marketing agency in Sofia". Name "Mira", role "Social media lead, Magnifito" (a fictional presenter for this demo). Show it from 0.6 s for 5 seconds, in the Magnifito colours: dark brown #2b1c17 badge with a beige #d8c6b4 accent bar and role line. The clip already has burned-in captions and an edit timeline at the bottom, so raise the badge to sit clear above them. Keep the audio.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f05-lower-third
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f05-lower-third/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 2.5 -t 8 -i ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/source.mp4
mgvideo lower-third work/source.mp4 --name 'Mira' --title 'Social media lead, Magnifito' --start 0.6 --duration 5 --color '#d8c6b4' --bg '#2b1c17' --bottom 310 --out work/lower-third.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/lower-third.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
